principle: NPC relationships evolve autonomously only from represented shared history and confirmed events. Edges are persistent, directional and multidimensional.
rules: The player is excluded from the autonomous NPC-to-NPC resolver.
A-to-B and B-to-A are separate edges and may evolve differently.
Co-location or shared membership alone does not create relationship state.
Confirmed encounters may increase familiarity without increasing friendship.
Professional respect may change independently of personal affinity/trust.
Friendship requires sustained positive shared-history evidence and sufficient familiarity.
Close friendship requires an existing friendship plus additional represented positive history.
Conflict may reduce trust/affinity without creating permanent hostility.
Apology and reconciliation may repair current dimensions but never erase prior conflict history.
Romantic eligibility uses the author-locked adult heterosexual canon.
Romantic compatibility does not create attraction.
Romantic interest is directional and requires causal event provenance.
Mutual romantic interest does not automatically create dating.
Dating/established relationship requires bilateral represented evidence.
Romantic rejection alone creates no automatic hostility or resentment.
Species identity, materialization, player proximity and camera observation are not relationship selectors.
Mentorship state is not advanced here; Step 12 owns mentors/instructors.
Wellbeing, discipline, campus-event and off-screen catch-up consequences remain later steps.
